name: BuildLedger
description: Software for Australian builders: less admin, supplier invoices captured, and a portal the client can see (company-stated). Pricing from $150 a month after a 14-day free trial (company-stated). Founded Nov 2025, Australia.

mentions.evidence: ~$1,659 MRR, 11 active subscriptions, ~$858 L30 (−19.4%), ~$2,405 last 3 months, ~$3,653 last 6 months, last 12 months and all-time ~$3,688. Revenue synced Oct 16, 2026 ~05:15 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: One trade and one country's paperwork. Charge a monthly fee and talk like a builder.

whyItPrints: Builders already hate paperwork. Supplier invoices and a client portal are the dull job. The country is specific, which is the point.
whyThisMatters:
Australian builders run jobs out of email, spreadsheets, and a calendar that does not talk to any of them. BuildLedger is one place for the quote, the crew, the costs, and the bill. Supplier invoices can come out of Gmail or Outlook and get filed against the job. You approve the ones it is unsure about. A client gets a link: photos, the claim, and the invoices behind it. Variations get a written yes or no.

It is built for Australia. GST, ABN, Australian dollars, and a two-way link with Xero. MYOB is described as coming later. Safety paperwork, purchase orders, and timesheets sit in the same job. There is a phone app. A free trial lasts two weeks, then a monthly plan starts unless you cancel. There is no lock-in. The company is young. The listing dates it to late 2025. Eleven subscriptions is a small start for a tool that wants to replace a builder's whole week of admin.

You pay so Sunday night is not spent matching receipts to a spreadsheet.
